products.title: Choose your new little friend
products.description: Small toys, playful shapes and different colours.

dragon.name: Flexi Dragon
dragon.shortDescription: A flexible little dragon for playing and collecting.
dragon.details: The Flexi Dragon is printed in one piece with connected movable parts, so it can bend and curl without assembly. The extra photos show different colour versions of the same dragon shape.
features: Available in bright and dark colour finishes

dinosaur.name: Mini Dinosaur
dinosaur.shortDescription: A small movable dinosaur with playful details.
dinosaur.details: The Mini Dinosaur is a compact articulated toy with movable body parts. Its small size makes it easy to carry, collect and give as a gift.

octopus.name: Flexi Octopus
octopus.shortDescription: A friendly octopus with movable arms.
octopus.details: The Flexi Octopus has several movable arms and a soft rounded design. It can be used as a playful desk toy, a small gift or a collectible figure.

cube.name: Shape Cube
cube.shortDescription: A compact toy with rotating shapes.
cube.details: The Shape Cube is a compact sensory toy with movable and rotating elements. It is created for curious hands and quiet play.

about.title: Made slowly. Played with endlessly.
